rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
Published the public website at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thank you for reaching out. I'm not in a position to give attributed quotes right now — I'm still sorting out some things on my end before I can speak publicly. I'd be happy to talk on background if that's useful for your piece, or to reconnect later once I'm able to speak on the record. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Tessa Brandt (reporter): Politely declined attributed quote, respecting your HR constraint. Offered background conversation later.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thank you for the invitation to sign. I'm not able to have my name or Halcyon Threshold's name on public letters right now due to some constraints I'm working through. I may be in a different position in a few weeks. If you're doing similar work in the future, please keep me in the loop. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Corvid Institute: Declined open letter signature for same reason. Left door open for future.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot. I'm still working out the direction, but I'd love to have you involved. The area I'm most interested in exploring is independent evaluations — measuring capabilities and behaviors that the labs don't publish about, or measuring them in ways that don't depend on lab self-reporting. Your data analysis skills would be directly relevant. Could we set up a call next week to talk through what this might look like? I should have a clearer picture by then. Thanks again for reaching out, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman: Accepted her volunteer offer, proposed a call next week to discuss evaluation work.
